prompt.generated_prompt_string: A soft-glam indoor portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman in three-quarter profile, seated with her torso angled slightly left and head turned right, one hand resting on top of her head in a natural hair-fixing gesture. She has a dark-brown loose updo with messy strands and soft flyaways, a calm softly focused gaze, serene expression, soft glam makeup, clean eyeliner, long lashes, peach blush, glossy coral-pink lips, and natural skin texture. She wears a black lace-trimmed slip-style fashion top with thin straps, deep V lace trim, scalloped edging, small center bow, subtle opaque-lined panels, and a matching draped skirt portion, plus large white floral statement earrings and a delicate gold chain with an emerald-green pendant. Set her in a minimal modern living-room corner with warm gray wall, potted plant on the left, black leather sofa in the foreground, and warm table lamp bokeh on the right. Use soft key light from front-left mixed with warm practical lamp light, approximately 4300K and 3000K, gentle shadow sculpting, a tight chest-up 3:4 frame, natural skin texture, subtle glow, shallow depth of field, and quiet late-evening warmth. Keep the fashion styling elegant, non-explicit, and editorial.
